global_rules: Mobile-first responsive design. Max-width on desktop (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen border-x border-zinc-200) to simulate app view.
Use generous padding (p-4 to p-6) for breathing room.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text.
Use optical alignment for icons and text.

hierarchy.caption: text-sm text-zinc-500
hierarchy.timer: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-mono font-light tracking-tighter text-zinc-900

components.header: sticky top-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200 z-50 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
components.card: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
components.record_button: w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xl shadow-indigo-600/20 flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-105 transition-transform active:scale-95
components.stop_button: w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-red-500 text-white shadow-xl shadow-red-500/20 flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-105 transition-transform active:scale-95
components.secondary_button: px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-900 rounded-xl font-medium transition-colors
components.icon_button: p-2 sm:p-3 rounded-full hover:bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 transition-colors

Home.empty_state: Center-aligned icon (e.g., Mic), warm prompt 'No lectures recorded yet. Tap the microphone to start.'
Home.floating_action: Fixed bottom-center Record button with safe-area padding.

Record.layout: Minimalist centered layout with high contrast.
Record.visuals: Massive monospace timer. Audio visualizer or pulsing concentric rings behind the mic icon.
Record.controls: Bottom aligned Pause and Stop buttons.

Processing.visuals: Staggered pulsing text or spinner. Steps indicator: Uploading > Transcribing > Structuring.

Notes_View.layout: Standard document view. Generous reading width.
Notes_View.content: Rich text rendering (H2s for concepts, bullet points for details, bold text for keywords).
Notes_View.actions: Bottom fixed bar or Top header icons for Export (PDF/Text) and Share (WhatsApp).

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind correctly and add custom fonts (Manrope, Figtree, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.html.
Build a mobile-first layout. Wrap the main app view in a container with 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative bg-zinc-50 border-x border-zinc-200 shadow-2xl' to simulate a mobile app on desktop.
Add data-testid to all actionable elements.
Use React MediaRecorder API or Web Audio API for recording functionality.
Mock API endpoints for transcription and note generation with realistic timeouts to show the processing screen.
Implement Web Share API for WhatsApp sharing if supported, else fallback to a mailto/clipboard approach.
